findings.text:
follow-on: the fragment is a heading with no landing element and no plan-verifies meta, so it attaches no evidence to §28 and no landing paragraph a reader can open; every sibling section-style fragment in the same directory (for example a-lift-is-drawn-once-per-pane.html) carries a

with the landing text, and docs/AGENTS.md:485 names a tiny standalone page as a recorded failure mode.

follow-on: the mutation harness _pointer_first_reading calls recovery_liveness._attempt_started_seconds, which the autouse fixture at line 83 has rebound to _pointer_first_reading itself, so any record with no attempt_started_at recurses forever; the negative-control log records RecursionError for test_an_attempt_only_start_reads_fresh_and_is_not_stalled, so one of its three red cases is the harness failing rather than a reading the restored defect produced.

follow-on: test_a_pointer_only_start_is_measured_from_that_one asserts _attempt_started_seconds(pointer) == started - STALE_SECONDS, where started - STALE_SECONDS is the same value the test handed the pointer at line 233, so the assertion holds under the pointer-first read it sits beside and could not redden on that regression; the case's only guarding assertion is the snapshot at line 246.

follow-on: _stub_resumed_run and _write_attempt_record duplicate the run-stubbing capability tests/test_stall_clock_starts_at_the_attempt.py:_stub_pointer:60 already owns for the same module under test -- both build a pointer through liveness._pointer, set it apart from a live host, backdate the stream with os.utime and write the run directory's attempt.json -- so a change to the attempt-record shape must now be made in two places.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 4 production call site(s): reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:527, reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:561, reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:1157, reckon/crew/placement.py:866
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base bdcad93fc; 988f0811b rewrites _attempt_started_seconds to read both records and return max(starts) and adds the 6-case test file, 609fff327 rewrites the new docstring's dated incident into the source docstring on reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:400-414 with no behavioural change, and the fragment is a 3-line section with heading only.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a new test file under a temporary crew home, a base/head gate over the test files importing the write paths each ending in EXIT=, and a reverting negative control; the manifest records baseline_suite (bdcad93fc, EXIT=1, 1 failure) and after_suite (988f0811b, EXIT=1, 1 failure, 189 passed) with their log paths and the negative-control log ends EXIT=1 with the declared first case red, but the gate ran at 988f0811b rather than the reviewed head 609fff327 and no log records the done_when's ruff clause.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to read a run's attempt start as the later of the pointer's and the attempt record's; reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:417-429 collects both attempt_started_at values, parses each, and returns max(starts).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 988f0811b and 609fff327, the fix and a 6-case test, the negative control at 3 failed/3 passed EXIT=1, and complete baseline_suite/after_suite JSON naming their logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py, tests/test_a_resumed_attempt_is_not_stalled_on_its_predecessor.py and the a-resumed-attempt-is-not-stalled-on-its-predecessor evidence fragment; the diff touches exactly those three and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the declared mutation is recorded and real: negative-control.log runs tests/test_a_resumed_attempt_is_not_stalled_on_its_predecessor.py with the pointer-first read restored, the first case fails, EXIT=1, so the guard reddens on the regression it was written against; two assertions in the same file (lines 243 and 274) instead compare against the value the test itself supplied and hold under that same regression, so they add no durability.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite are complete (baseline EXIT=1 with failure_ids [tests/test_recovery_state_typing.py::test_causes_with_opposite_recoveries_have_distinct_types] at 183 passed, after EXIT=1 with the same single id at 189 passed), so added_failure_count is 0 against a red base, but the head gate log's own header names 988f0811b rather than the reviewed head 609fff327 and no log records the done_when's ruff clause though I confirmed 1 pre-existing finding at both base and head with the repo config.
justifications.fit: the rewrite stays inside _attempt_started_seconds, keeps the existing parse_utc/_run_directory idiom of the surrounding module at reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:398-429, and every name it touches carries no plan, stage or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:417-429 reads the pointer's and attempt.json's attempt_started_at, keeps every one that parses, and returns max(starts), which is exactly the done_when's 'returns the later parseable start'.
justifications.reuse: the production change extends the existing owner rather than forking it -- no new module or symbol is added -- but the test file's _stub_resumed_run and _write_attempt_record (lines 95 and 108) re-implement the run-stubbing helper tests/test_stall_clock_starts_at_the_attempt.py:_stub_pointer:60 already owns for the same module under test, with a parameterisation rather than an import or a call.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff bdcad93fc..609fff327 (reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py, tests/test_a_resumed_attempt_is_not_stalled_on_its_predecessor.py, the evidence fragment) is inside the manifest's declared write_paths.
